name: @polaris-app/hospitality
description: Hospitality: run a bar or restaurant - the menu, the floor, orders, the kitchen and the till - on the local network. An installable Polaris app.

summary.en-US: Run a bar or restaurant on your own network.
summary.es-ES: Lleva un bar o restaurante en tu propia red.

description.en-US: Keep the menu with prices, taxes and allergens, import it from a spreadsheet and change prices in bulk. Waiters take orders from a phone or tablet and the bar sees them at once, all on the venue's own network, with no internet needed. Uninstalling keeps the menu and every order.
description.es-ES: Ten la carta con precios, IVA y alérgenos, impórtala de una hoja y cambia precios de golpe. Los camareros toman comandas desde el móvil o la tablet y la barra las ve al momento, todo en la red del local, sin necesitar internet. Al desinstalar se conservan la carta y los pedidos.

label.en-US: Take orders and use the till
Run the menu, the floor and the reports
